name: relock-control
title: Relock control
description: Lets the consumer hide a preview on a shared screen. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

meta.whenToUse: One deliberate way to put the preview away on a shared screen, inside chrome you have already built.
meta.notFor: Previews that already use Preview bar or Preview chrome. Both include this control, and two relock buttons is the usual duplication.
pitfalls: Activating calls `onRelock` and does nothing else. Hiding the content, and returning focus to the gate, remain yours.
meta.contract: Lets the consumer hide a preview on a shared screen. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

props.name: onRelock
props.description: Called on activation. Consumer must hide content and end access as appropriate; required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable while the consumer is processing.

props.name: theme
props.description: Explicit theme; omitted follows the system preference.

meta.a11y: Native controls, visible focus, localized labels; lifecycle messages use polite announcements. No modal dialog is created.

docs: UI only. Read https://knock.codes/docs/relock-control.md. Consumers own authorization.
